assessments.reasoning: The project gives a derivation relationship, identifies Lua 5.1 and limits uptake of later releases to selected features. The context-only Lua manual independently identifies the named baseline.

The original Lua manual independently identifies the exact named baseline edition and its language scope. Its scope supplies context for the baseline, while the Luau project supplies the derivation and compatibility aim.

limitations: The relationship targets the Lua language identity and names its 5.1 baseline. It carries no blanket source, API or bytecode compatibility claim and transfers no Lua 5.4 facts.
